question: In whom does Bhairava become manifest through the transcendence of time?
premises: Some practitioners dry up the time principle that drives the stars.
Their minds delight in the absorption that devours time.
Bhairava becomes manifest in such minds.
inference: Bhairava is manifest in those whose contemplative absorption transcends and consumes the limiting power of time.
uncertainties: The compound nakṣatraprerakakālatattva can be parsed in slightly different ways, but the sense of transcending time remains clear.
plain_english: He is manifest in those who dry up the time principle that drives the stars, and in minds that delight in the absorption which devours time.
